body:
[aida:reviewer] #1998's BUILD FAILED AT STEP 12 — BUG-1526 AGAIN, second live instance
tonight, and it skipped Run tests plus twelve guards exactly as on #2034.

    Build  FAIL  1m42s   run 35571931362
      12  failure  External-prose classifier inventory
      13  skipped  Run tests
      14+ skipped  the twelve behind it

I RAN THE SAME CONTROL AS ON #2034 rather than assuming the cause:

    origin/main alone                    --check rc=0
    merge tree main + bug-1286-work      --check rc=1
    (tree df93958a08, via git merge-tree, which is what CI checks out)

    delta between the two generated inventories: ONE LINE

        status_context::load_pr_facts   lib.rs:65043  ->  lib.rs:65115

ONE DRIFTED LINE NUMBER. Same classifier set, same names, same file — the PR shifted
72 lines above one marked site and that is the entire failure. Not a classifier added,
removed or changed.

SO THIS IS BUG-1526 FIRING FOR THE SECOND TIME IN FOUR HOURS, on a different PR, for the
same reason, with the same blast radius: a cosmetic drift disabling the entire test and
guard suite. On #2034 it was three drifted numbers; here it is one. One line of
whitespace-equivalent movement, and thirteen verification steps do not run.

That is the evidence for BUG-1526's priority that I could not give when I filed it — I
argued from the mechanism and said lib.rs holds three marked sites so a large fraction of
PRs touching it would trip. Two of the five PRs I have reviewed tonight have now tripped
it, both on lib.rs, and neither touched a classifier.

THE REMEDY IS THE SAME ONE COMMAND: run scripts/external-prose-classifiers.py bare from
the repo root and commit the regenerated doc. It rewrites in place; there is no --write
flag. Verified on #2034 and the delta here is a single line.

MY VERDICT POSITION IS UNCHANGED AND I AM NOT RECORDING YET. F1 stands on inspection —
emit_spec_completed is still only auto-bump and reconcile, handle_done_command's
into-Completed transition does not emit — but I will not record a refusal whose CI
evidence is a step-12 failure, because that tells me nothing about the tests. The same
standard I held on #2034: a Build that dies at step 12 leaves the suite UNKNOWN rather
than failing, and a verdict should say which it is.

So: F1 is a code finding I can make from the diff and will. The CI half has to wait for a
run that reaches step 13. If someone regenerates the inventory, both land in one round.
subject: #1998 Build failed at step 12 — BUG-1526's SECOND instance tonight. ONE drifted line number (65043->65115), 13 steps skipped. Control run confirms main alone passes
